entries.note: Released automatically from main; each release's exact version and commit are shown in its build record.

Added: Material Design 3 redesign with a navigation rail, a bottom bar for narrow windows and a live tunnel diagram
Sessions history with search, filters, statistics, bulk actions and JSON, CSV or Markdown export
Features screen with an honest status for every planned feature
Offline guide with every website article
Settings with search, regex builder, settings history and per-group reset
English, Hong Kong Cantonese and bilingual modes with playfulness sliders
Command palette on Ctrl+Shift+F, context menus, notification centre and two-key confirmations
Focus modes, text size, density, accent colour, motion levels and action sounds
Version and build time on the first screen, and a release on every build of main

Base64 files beside their originals: drop or choose files to write name.ext.base64.txt next to each one, or drop the .txt to get the original back with its name and extension, streamed with pause and cancel, never overwriting and checked by SHA-256

Virtual disks under Tools: a library of attached disks and VHD, VHDX, VHD Set and ISO files with details read from the file header; attach, detach, grow, shrink, compact, convert, differencing children, merge, new parent path, new identifier, metadata and offline or read-only fixes, each with its PowerShell and DiskPart equivalent; a New virtual disk sheet with presets, volume preparation and free-space checks; and Quick pack, which turns dropped files and folders into a VHDX beside them that grows by itself when they do not fit and checks every file by SHA-256
Changed: The navigation rail writes each destination's name beside its icon on wide windows; the menu button at its top, or Settings › Appearance › Navigation rail, collapses it to the compact rail
The website was rebuilt with the feature inventory, articles, language modes and a command palette
Windows title bar drawn by the app, with the version, dim sum code name and build time, and Windows' own caption buttons and Snap layouts
One Material 3 type scale, focus rings around search boxes, menu items and date fields, and buttons whose corners square up when pressed
Settings rows stack their controls under the label on narrow windows; schedule rules reflow to fit
The public link wraps only after dots, dashes and slashes, and steps down in size on narrow windows
No toast for news the Host screen already shows; the bell still records it
Fixed: Text size above 100 percent cut off the bottom of the window
Screen readers read icon names such as "content_copy"; menus, tabs and the bottom navigation used invalid roles
Cantonese text inside filled buttons had too little contrast; Starting status was below 4.5 to 1 in the light theme
Schedule switches showed untranslated on and off, and the confirm slider covered its own instruction
Sessions chart date labels shrank to unreadable sizes on narrow windows
Website dialogs let the keyboard leave them; the Show all features button had a grey browser fill

entries.note: Development preview. Not published as a release.

Added: Host a Dockerfile or Compose project and share it through a verified Cloudflare Quick Tunnel
Isolated, app-owned containers with cleanup that keeps volumes
